issues.description: endActivity() lacked planName and durationMs parameters, so the native LiveActivityManager could not render the completed-state UI required by REQ-023/AC-022.
issues.suggestion: Fixed: updated signature to endActivity({required String planName, required int durationMs}) and passed both values to the native channel. Added call site in now_playing_screen.dart _handleCompletion using state.plan.name and state.plan.totalDuration.inMilliseconds.

issues.description: The _StatTile Semantics node used excludeSemantics: true with only '$value $label', suppressing the sublabel ('Completed today ✓' / 'No session yet today') from the accessibility tree. Screen readers could not announce completion status.
issues.suggestion: Fixed: added optional semanticLabel parameter to _StatTile. _StreakStatTile now assembles a full label (e.g. '10 Streak, Completed today') from completedTodayAsync before excludeSemantics suppresses the child tree, and passes it as semanticLabel.

issues.description: Loading state rendered a bare CircularProgressIndicator with no Semantics label; screen readers announced only 'Progress indicator' with no context.
issues.suggestion: Fixed: wrapped with Semantics(label: 'Loading shared plan', child: CircularProgressIndicator()).

issues.description: Loading indicator Semantics label was 'Sharing in progress' — functional but low context.
issues.suggestion: Updated label to 'Sharing plan, please wait' to clearly describe the ongoing action.

issues.description: No validation that the combined _startDateTime was in the future. A user selecting today + a past time would create a calendar event in the past.
issues.suggestion: Fixed: added guard at top of _addToCalendar() that checks _startDateTime.isAfter(DateTime.now()) and shows a SnackBar if not.

issues.description: Weekday header labels ('Su', 'Mo', etc.) had no semantic enhancement; screen readers announced abbreviated text without full day names.
issues.suggestion: Fixed: each header is now wrapped in Semantics(label: fullDayName) with ExcludeSemantics on the visual Text child, so VoiceOver/TalkBack announces 'Sunday', 'Monday', etc.

issues.description: Drag handle Semantics node was missing excludeSemantics: true, unlike the StreakCalendarSheet pattern.
issues.suggestion: Fixed: added excludeSemantics: true to match the established pattern.

issues.description: Streak badge used hardcoded Colors.white for the flame icon and count text, which could produce low contrast on light-primary themes.
issues.suggestion: Fixed: changed both to colorScheme.onPrimary to respect the Material You theme contract.

summary: All three blocking issues resolved: endActivity() now accepts planName/durationMs and is called on completion; the streak _StatTile semantic label now includes completion status before excludeSemantics suppresses the child tree; the shared plan loading state has a descriptive Semantics label. Minor and nit issues addressed: past-datetime validation added to calendar sheet, weekday headers have full-name semantic labels, share button loading state has a clearer label, drag handle excludeSemantics matches established pattern, and milestone badge uses colorScheme.onPrimary instead of hardcoded white. The web fallback page (web/app/s/[token]/page.tsx) and error message sanitisation were already correctly implemented.
